messages:
Lena (Sales AE): HelioPharm wants a 14-day on-prem Private POC. Air-gapped. They asked for a short install preflight + how we hand ephemeral API access via a bastion. Need for Legal/InfoSec.
Omar (Infra Eng): Understood. High-level checks: GPU driver, CUDA runtime, kernel version, container runtime, k8s version, nvidia device plugin, cgroup mode, time sync. I'll list safe commands.
Pri (Solutions Eng): Ephemeral token flow we support: Console mints signed grant -> bastion posts to validate endpoint over mTLS -> exchange returns short-lived creds (1-6h). We'll require client certs for the bastion.
Gabi (FieldTech): For air-gap we provide: image tarball, helm chart, mirror script. Customer must host a Docker v2 registry (Harbor/Quay). We'll give an example Harbor config.
Omar (Infra Eng): Safe probe commands (no cluster-admin):

    # GPU + driver
    nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv

    # CUDA/toolkit
    if command -v nvcc >/dev/null; then nvcc --version; else ls /usr/local | grep cuda || true; fi

    # Kernel modules
    uname -r; lsmod | egrep 'nvidia|nvrm' || true

    # Container runtime
    ps -ef | egrep 'containerd|dockerd' || true

Pri (Solutions Eng): Ports to call out for InfoSec: kube-apiserver 6443, etcd 2379/2380 (if self-hosted), node-metrics 9100, DCGM 9400, optional outbound 443 for artifact proxy.
Gabi (FieldTech): KMS note: we support Vault transit/HSM. No key export. Agent calls transit endpoint; keys remain on-site. We'll include PKCS#11 compatibility note.
Lena (Sales AE): Procurement asked for pricing for 4x A100 for 14 days. Marcus (Finance) will post a quote.
mirror-bot: Mirror job created: helio/1898765432 (image bundle ready)
HelioPharm-ops: We can run the commands tomorrow 09:00 PST and post results. Also confirm Harbor + Vault on-prem.
Omar (Infra Eng): Known pitfalls to flag: SELinux Enforcing often blocks device-plugin mounts (recommend Permissive during install), older kernels (<5.4) may need patches for modern CUDA, cgroup v2 runtime issues. We'll add a short compatibility matrix link.
Pri (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a one-page preflight + 3-bullet FAQ (ephemeral tokens, mirror flow, troubleshooting) and post here by EOD.
Lena (Sales AE): Perfect, thanks team. HelioPharm-ops, please upload results when ready and we'll review blockers quickly.
